name: Engine-assigned Investment category with no own-money evidence stays an ordinary movement, never savings at risk (G434)

expected.notes: G434 control. Same accounts and 300 order as the other G434 scenarios (Chase Current A 150, B 600, C 200, order dated Thu 26 Nov, today Wed 25 Nov), but the series is a third-party platform the ENGINE filed as Investment: no destination, no own-savings stamp, no user choice, so the category alone does not make it own savings and it stays an ordinary movement, as before G434. A: 150 - 300 = -150, verdict short; movement-only so at risk count 0 and no cover engine: no savings fact, no move. Left to spend 950 - 300 = 650. Allocation in listed order: A 0 (negative), B min(600, 650) = 600, C min(200, 50) = 50; total 650. G436 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the Left to spend and Spend from figures worked above where they differ: Each figure is the account's own, nothing is filled in a preferred order: acc-a is short 150 with no cover, so -150 (after payments -150, low point -150); acc-b 600; acc-c 200 (G414 gave it 50 because the allocation ran out). -150 + 600 + 200 = 650 = Left to spend.
